acceptance: 45.92% latency saving and exact behavior/settings/unchanged dependency identities pass. Candidates export no intermediate output. Defaults and pins remain unchanged; total-cost and rollout gates stay open.

cost_decision.limits: The declared checkpoint was already warm. The runner warmup-only two-edit figure excludes mandatory costs and cannot establish the workflow budget. Historical full-cost results remain unaccepted. This campaign compares consume-only against clean, not against export-enabled incremental builds.
remaining: fresh seed creation and missing-seed first use
cost_decision.status: incomplete; no adoption or ten-edit acceptance

implementation_declaration.costQualification: The declared checkpoint is already available. Warmups cannot prove seed creation cost; fresh checkpoint creation/origin validation, transfer, retention and final rollout accounting remain separate required acceptance before adoption.
implementation_declaration.scope: Native aarch64-darwin consume-only core experiment; defaults unchanged

interruptions: Initial launch stopped before measured pairs because another host compiler was active. Identity-checked resume preserved warmups and the complete prefix. All five retained pairs compiled fresh targets and passed verification.

measurement.compiler_count_semantics: GHC Compiling events, including Setup and repeated module names across components
measurement.cost_limits: migration_cost_seconds is the candidate warmup only, retained for receipt compatibility. Cached warmups cannot establish seed creation cost. Include independently measured seed creation, source/recipe migration, final validation, transfer and retention before any adoption decision; break_even_edits excludes those additional costs.
measurement.evaluation_cache: Nix expression evaluation, fresh process per invocation; no flake output evaluation cache
